news.title: 1st Test, Basin Reserve: Gill wins toss and bowls; Bumrah back after a year out; NZ 60/4 at lunch on day one
news.note: Bumrah 2/17 (Latham bowled for a duck in his first over, then Mitchell), Akash Deep 1/15 (Ravindra), Kamboj 1 (Conway). Bumrah's comeback is the story of the day; the Replay Room long video lands the day after the Test.

news.title: India's XI: four seamers (Bumrah, Akash Deep, Kamboj, Prasidh) plus Washington Sundar; Pant keeps with Jurel also in; no Jadeja or Siraj
news.note: Gill's four-seamer plan happened, and on a green, damp pitch. Selection debate (Sundar over Jadeja, Prasidh over Siraj) is a ready myth/tactics angle.

news.title: Context: India have not won a Test in NZ since 2009, only one Basin Reserve win (1968); NZ top the WTC table, India fourth; average first-innings score at the Basin is 313
news.note: Ready-made hook numbers; re-check the WTC table on icc-cricket.com before using.

news.title: Santner out of the series with a fractured hand; NZ pick four seamers, Conway and Ravindra back
news.note: NZ have no front-line spinner: an all-pace Test, rare at the Basin. Also: Gill has 1,024 runs this WTC cycle, most of anyone (verify).

news.title: MI captaincy still not announced after the Hardik trade; Rohit, Bumrah, Surya, Tilak in contention
news.note: No change today; keep the pre-built Short ready.
